scope: Tested context boundaries, not an exhaustive builtin or grammar specification

ordinary_function.values: finite f64, bool, string, null, lists and runtime handles
ordinary_function.validation: parsing does not resolve every runtime call

editor.validation: balanced structure with recovery; does not enforce edition, call validity or tensor semantics

let_groups.evaluation: left-to-right once; later initializers see earlier bindings; no group rollback

declarations: environment NAME { observation:f32[N]; action:f32[A]; feedback:f32[F]; reset:FUNCTION; step:FUNCTION; }
agent_environment.learner: static synchronous two-parameter user function; original target and full RecordBatch
agent_environment.updates: policy identity protected while collecting; unlock before learner; no automatic optimizer
agent_environment.environment: constructor reset once; fixed state schema; complete validation before committing state/observation/done/RNG
agent_environment.termination: terminated and truncated independent; either requires reset before step
agent_environment.rng: instance-local; reset replays original seed; host stream unchanged
agent_environment.checkpoint: model policy only; no agent/environment snapshot

async_tasks.executor: local future polling; fixed 2 worker blocking IO pool and 64 queued operations
async_tasks.budget: shared parent operations; spawn ordinal RNG split
io: await load text from path; 64 MiB maximum, metadata-sized shared reservation, worker settles actual bytes and returns unused reservation
async_tasks.host_compute: explicitly rejected before future or scope creation
async_tasks.aot: native Rust future control flow; no AST replay

training_strategy.target: declared synchronous ordinary user function with exactly three parameters; static binding ignores locals; forward declarations allowed
training_strategy.evaluation: MODEL,INPUTS,TARGETS left-to-right once; strategy once; return discarded
training_strategy.updates: explicit strategy-controlled zero or more commits; no implicit optimizer, retry or whole-function rollback
training_strategy.hyperparameters: defined in strategy body; using mutually exclusive with rate/clip

file_syntax.host_policy: direct path IO denied; use capabilities
file_syntax.assert: assert CONDITION [, MESSAGE]; strict bool; message lazy on failure; two-argument function remains eager

slicing.ordinary: lists; runtime integer endpoints; empty allowed
slicing.tensor: 1D f32; compile-time numeric endpoints; empty rejected

categorical_vectors.normalization: logits stable softmax subtracts maximum; probabilities validate and preserve values
categorical_vectors.metadata: runtime values and model/optimizer-checkpoint output contracts; missing artifact field defaults to f32
categorical_vectors.gradient: softmax VJP for logits; identity for validated probabilities

categorical_sampling.model: local model handle variable or function parameter
categorical_sampling.input: one expression evaluated once; finite f32 vector matching model input
categorical_sampling.output: zero-based categorical index; explicit logits stable softmax, probabilities validate and sample actual mass, legacy f32 retains logits interpretation
categorical_sampling.rng: one script RNG draw per successful sample

sample_record.evaluation: one model evaluation and RNG draw; scalar sample stays scalar
sample_record.log_probability: stable f64 logits log-sum-exp or log(p_action)-log(sum(p))

record_batches.chunks: for part in batch size positive_integer
record_batches.order: preserved, no implicit shuffle; tail retained; empty zero chunks
record_batches.schema: same field set, kinds and homogeneous fixed list shapes
record_batches.scope: yield belongs to nearest lexical collect in same function; return propagates
